## R Markdown

Small RNAsequencing was performed on small RNA extracted from extracellular vesicles from plasma collected postpartum from inviduals who experienced preeclampsia with postpartum headache (n=13), preeclampsia without postpartum headache (n=13), and normotensive individuals (n=13) Extracellular vesicles were isolated from Motherhealth plasma samples using the Izon SEC platform. RNA was extracted using the miRNeasy isolation kit.  Out of 39 samples sent to RealSeq for small RNAseq, 35 were successfully sequenced.  FASTQ files were received with adapters trimmed.  The reads were aligned using STAR version 2.7.10b using the gencode v43 human reference genome (hg38). Counts were generated using the featureCounts function of Rsubread 2.12.3 and annotated for sRNA using the ITAS database (62703 elements detected). Low abundant reads were filtered with a cutoff of mean count > 5, with 22960 elements remaining (https://www.mdpi.com/1422-0067/24/4/4195).  The data was filtered, normalized, and assessed for differential expression analysis using DESeq2. Filtering criteria were implemented to drop lowly expressed features (based on rowMeans < 0.05), retaining 22904 features. The most abundant feature biotypes were protein-coding genes (n=15,736), lncRNA (n=4735), and pseudogenes (n=1809).  Small-noncoding RNA, including miRNA (n=111), snRNA (n=46), snoRNA (n=14), scRNA (n=1), and sRNA (n=1) were also detected. Differential expression of 8 features were identified at an FDR < 0.05 comparing preeclampsia cases vs. controls, adjusting for collection time.  Two loci were upregulated (hsa-miR-335-5p, rRNA-hsa-dup24-sep-1257) and 6 were downregulation (hsa-piR-32870,tRNA-Phe-GAA-5-1, 5S-dup22-seq-658, hsa-piR-5019,hsa-piR-32859,hsa-piR-32989). Additionally adjusted for 3 surrogate variables, 50 differentially expressed loci are identified.  hsa-miR-335-5p remains the top most differentially expressed.

C19MC coordinates were obtained from the Bentwich et al., 2005 paper (https://www.nature.com/articles/ng1590) and converted to hg38 coordinates using UCSC genome browser (chr19:53666679-53766338);

Workflow for snRNA annotation using ITAS: https://github.com/EpiEpiMSU/ITAS (Stupnikov et al., 2022: https://www.mdpi.com/2311-553X/8/3/30).
Compiled databases include miRbase (miRNA), GtRNAdb (tRNA),

# find file locations of bam files
```{r bam_location}

# Function to recursively search for files with specific extensions
find_files <- function(directory, extensions) {
  files <- dir_ls(directory, recurse = TRUE)
  filtered_files <- files[str_detect(files, paste0("\\.", extensions, "$"))]
  as.character(filtered_files)
}

# path to directory
directory <- "../../../Data/RNAseq/STAR/STAR_align_clean"

# Replace with the directory you want to search in
extensions <- c("bam")     # Replace with the desired extensions

file_locations <- find_files(directory, extensions)
print(file_locations)

file.exists(file_locations)

#35 files
```

## demotable
```{r demo}
demo_preeclampsia<-Covariates%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(SID,seqid,bam,combined_group,Headache))%>%
tbl_summary(
    by = Group,
    statistic = list(all_continuous()  ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
                     all_categorical() ~ "{n}    ({p}%)"),
    digits = list(all_continuous()  ~ c(2, 2),
                  all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)),
    type = list(Collection_interval ~ "continuous",
                BMI ~ "categorical",
                Race.ethnicity ~ "categorical",
                delivery_mode ~ "categorical",
                Gest.age ~ "continuous"),
    label  = list(Collection_interval ~ "Time to collection (days)",
                BMI ~ "BMI at Delivery",
                Race.ethnicity ~ "Race/ethnicity",
                delivery_mode ~ "Delivery Mode",
                Gest.age ~ "Gestational age (weeks)")
  ) %>%
  add_p(pvalue_fun = ~ style_pvalue(.x, digits = 2)) %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Variable**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>N = {n} ({style_percent(p, digits=1)}%)") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption("<div style='text-align: left; font-weight: bold;'> Participant characteristics by Preeclampsia status</div>")
```

## count features and annotate snRNAs
```{r}
#snrna only
gtffile <- file.path("../../../Data/RNAseq/ITAS/Integrated_annotation/human/human_allRNA/human_allRNA.gtf")

fc<-featureCounts(files=file_locations, 
                  annot.ext=gtffile, 
                  isGTFAnnotationFile = TRUE, 
                  GTF.featureType = "exon", 
                  GTF.attrType = "transcript_id", 
                  minFragLength=15,
                  isPairedEnd=FALSE)
```

## create DESeq2 dataset
```{r}
dds<-DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=fc$counts,
                            colData=Covariates,
                            design= ~ Gest.age + BMI + Group)

dds
#class: DESeqDataSet 
#dim: 18948 35 
#metadata(1): version
```

```{r}
  mutate(TXTYPE=factor(ifelse(grepl("hsa-let|hsa-miR",Gene),"miRNA",
```

## top most expressed genes
```{r}
select<-order(rowMeans(counts(dds,normalized=TRUE)),
                decreasing=TRUE)[1:25]

top.genes<-assay(vsd)[select,]

top.genes%>%
  as_tibble(.,rownames=NA)%>%
  rownames_to_column(var="sRNA")%>%
  pivot_longer(-c("sRNA"),names_to="ID", values_to="counts")%>%
  group_by(sRNA)%>%
  ggplot(.,aes(x=fct_reorder(sRNA, counts, .fun = median, .desc =TRUE),y=counts))+
  geom_boxplot(fill="grey60")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text=element_text(angle=45,vjust=1,hjust=1))+
  labs(y="Normalized counts")
```


## C19MC profile
```{r}
#restrict to miRNAs

txdb_miRNA<-txdb_dds[txdb_dds$TXTYPE=="miRNA",]
txdb_miRNA<-txdb_miRNA%>%
  mutate(mirbase_id=str_remove(Gene,"-3p|-5p"))%>%
  distinct(mirbase_id,.keep_all=TRUE)

ensembl = useMart("ensembl",dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

miRNA_location<-getBM(attributes=c('mirbase_id', 'chromosome_name',"start_position","end_position"), 
      filters = 'mirbase_id', 
      values = txdb_miRNA$mirbase_id, 
      mart = ensembl)

miRNA_location<-miRNA_location%>%
  dplyr::rename(start="start_position",end="end_position")%>%
  mutate(chromosome_name=paste0("chr",chromosome_name))

miRNA_gr<-makeGRangesFromDataFrame(miRNA_location,
                         keep.extra.columns=TRUE,
                         ignore.strand=FALSE,
                         seqinfo=NULL,
                         seqnames.field=c("chromosome_name"),
                         start.field="start",
                         end.field="end")

C19MC_gr<-  GRanges(
    seqnames = "chr19",
    ranges = IRanges(53666679, 53766338))

intersect(miRNA_gr, C19MC_gr) #no overlap with C19MC
```


## conduct surrogate variable analysis
```{r SVA}
dat  <- getVarianceStabilizedData(dds)
idx  <- rowMeans(dat) > 1 #all
dat  <- dat[idx, ]
mod <- model.matrix(~Gest.age + BMI + Group,colData(dds))
mod0 <- model.matrix(~   1, colData(dds))

n.sv <- num.sv(dat,mod,method="be") #3
svseq <- svaseq(dat, mod, mod0, n.sv = 3)

ddssva <- dds
ddssva$SV1 <- svseq$sv[,1]
ddssva$SV2 <- svseq$sv[,2]
ddssva$SV3 <- svseq$sv[,3]


## save SV data
SVs=svseq$sv
colnames(SVs) <- paste0("SV",seq(1:3))
rownames(SVs)<-dds$SID
write.csv(SVs,"../../../Data/Covariates/SVs_sRNAsubset.csv")

## save vst-normalized data
saveRDS(dat,"normalized_data/vst.RDS")

```


## conduct differential gene expression analysis with respect to preeclampsia including Gestational age and BMI as covariates
```{r}

design(dds) <- ~ Gest.age + BMI + Collection_interval  + Group

dds<-DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds,contrast=c("Group","Preeclampsia","Normotensive"))
res<-res[order(res$pvalue),]
res
summary(res)
sum(res$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE) #9933

res<-as.data.frame(res)

res<-res%>%
  rownames_to_column(var="gene_id")

## volcano plot
res_volcano_05<-res%>%
  mutate(sig=factor(ifelse(padj < 0.05,"sig","not.sig")))%>%
  drop_na(padj)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj), colour=sig,label=gene_id))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("black", "red")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(padj<0.05,as.character(gene_id),"")),max.overlaps=30)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1.5, 1.5), linetype="dashed") +
  labs(x=bquote(~Log[2] ~ "fold change"),y=bquote(~-Log[10] ~ "Adj.P-value"),title="Preeclampsia DEGs adjusted for GA age, BMI, blood collection interval (sRNA subset)")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = 'black',size=1),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = (1.2)),
        panel.grid.minor=element_line(),
        axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"),
        axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = "none")

pdf("DESeq2/Plots/volcano_preeclampsia_adjbloodGABMI_sRNAsubset.pdf",width=8)
res_volcano_05
dev.off()

saveRDS(res,"DESeq2/res_preeclampsia_adjbloodGABMI_sRNAsubset.rds")
```


## conduct differential gene expression analysis with respect to preeclampsia, including gestational age, BMI, blood collection time and SVs as covariates

```{r}
SVs<-read.csv("../../../Data/Covariates/SVs_sRNAsubset.csv")

dds$SV2=SVs$SV2
dds$SV3=SVs$SV3

design(dds) <- ~ Gest.age + BMI + Collection_interval + SV1 + SV2 + SV3 + Group

dds<-DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds,contrast=c("Group","Preeclampsia","Normotensive"))
res<-res[order(res$pvalue),]
res
```

## conduct differential gene expression analysis with respect to preeclampsia and headache status, including collection interval as covariates
```{r}
design(dds) <- ~ Gest.age + BMI + Collection_interval  + combined_group

dds<-DESeq(dds)

res_headache <- results(dds,contrast=c("combined_group","Preeclampsia_Yes","Normotensive_No"))
res_headache<-res_headache[order(res_headache$pvalue),]
res_headache
summary(res_headache)
sum(res_headache$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE) #20

res_headache<-as.data.frame(res_headache)

res_headache<-res_headache%>%
  rownames_to_column(var="gene_id")

## volcano plot
res_volcano_05<-res_headache%>%
  mutate(sig=factor(ifelse(padj < 0.05,"sig","not.sig")))%>%
  drop_na(padj)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log2FoldChange, y=-log10(padj), colour=sig,label=gene_id))+
  geom_point(alpha=0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c("black", "red")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label=ifelse(padj<0.05,as.character(gene_id),"")),max.overlaps=20)+
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.05), linetype="dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-1.5, 1.5), linetype="dashed") +
  labs(x=bquote(~Log[2] ~ "fold change"),y=bquote(~-Log[10] ~ "Adj.P-value"),title="Preeclampsia headache DEGs adjusted for GA, BMI, and blood collection interval (sRNA subset)")+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(panel.border = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = 'black',size=1),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = (1.2)),
        panel.grid.minor=element_line(),
        axis.title=element_text(size=14,face="bold"),
        axis.text=element_text(size=12),
        legend.position = "none")

pdf("DESeq2/Plots/volcano_preeclampsia_headache_adjbloodGABMI_sRNAsubset.pdf")
res_volcano_05
dev.off()

saveRDS(res_headache,"DESeq2/res_preeclampsia_headache_adjbloodGABMI_sRNAsubset.rds")



res_noheadache <- results(dds,contrast=c("combined_group","Preeclampsia_No","Normotensive_No"))
res_noheadache<-res_noheadache[order(res_noheadache$pvalue),]
res_noheadache
summary(res_noheadache)
sum(res_noheadache$padj < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE) #83

res_noheadache<-as.data.frame(res_noheadache)

res_noheadache<-res_noheadache%>%
  rownames_to_column(var="gene_id")

## volcano plot
```

## overlap in DESEQ2 hits (upset)
```{r}
overall<-readRDS("DESeq2/res_preeclampsia_adjbloodGABMI_sRNAsubset.rds")
overall_SV<-readRDS("DESeq2/res_preeclampsia_adjdemoSVs_sRNAsubset.rds")
headache<-readRDS("DESeq2/res_preeclampsia_headache_adjbloodGABMI_sRNAsubset.rds")
headache_SV<-readRDS("DESeq2/res_preeclampsia_headache_adjdemoSVs_sRNAsubset.rds")
noheadache<-readRDS("DESeq2/res_preeclampsia_noheadache_adjbloodGABMI_sRNAsubset.rds")
noheadache_SV<-readRDS("DESeq2/res_preeclampsia_noheadache_adjdemoSVs_sRNAsubset.rds")



# Original code
list.DFs <- list(overall, overall_SV, headache, headache_SV, noheadache, noheadache_SV)
list.DFs <- map(list.DFs, ~filter(.x, padj < 0.05))

# Modified code to name the dataframes
filtered_list <- setNames(list.DFs, c("overall", "overall_SV", "headache", "headache_SV", "noheadache", "noheadache_SV"))

# Extract gene_ids from each named dataframe
filtered_gene_ids <- lapply(filtered_list, function(df) df$gene_id)


listInput <- list(overall=filtered_gene_ids$overall,overall_SV=filtered_gene_ids$overall_SV,headache=filtered_gene_ids$headache,headache_SV=filtered_gene_ids$headache_SV,noheadache=filtered_gene_ids$noheadache,noheadache_SV=filtered_gene_ids$noheadache_SV)

upset(fromList(listInput), order.by = "freq")


listInput <- list(overall=filtered_gene_ids$overall_SV,headache=filtered_gene_ids$headache_SV,noheadache=filtered_gene_ids$noheadache_SV)

upset(fromList(listInput), order.by = "freq")

```

## overlap venn diagram
```{r}
myCol <- brewer.pal(3, "Pastel2")

venn.diagram(x = list(filtered_gene_ids$overall_SV, filtered_gene_ids$headache_SV, filtered_gene_ids$noheadache_SV),
        category.names = c("Overall" , "Headache" , "No Headache"),
        filename = 'DESeq2/Plots/VennDiagram_adjdemoSVs_sRNAsubset.png',
        output=TRUE,
        
        # Output features
        imagetype="png" ,
        height = 480 , 
        width = 480 , 
        resolution = 300,
        compression = "lzw",
        
        # Circles
        lwd = 2,
        lty = 'blank',
        fill = myCol,
        
        # Numbers
        cex = .6,
        fontface = "bold",
        fontfamily = "sans",
        
        # Set names
        cat.cex = 0.5,
        cat.fontface = "bold",
        cat.default.pos = "outer",
        cat.pos = c(-20, 20, 135),
        cat.dist = c(0.055, 0.055, 0.085),
        cat.fontfamily = "sans",
        rotation = 1
)
```

## Gene Ontology enrichment
```{r}
#overall_hits
overall_hits<-overall_SV%>%
  filter(padj<0.05)%>%
  pull(gene_id)

multimir_overall_validated_results<-get_multimir(org="hsa",
                                   mirna=overall_hits,
                                   table='validated',
                                   summary=TRUE)

multimir_overall_validated_distinct<-multimir_overall_validated_results@data%>%
  distinct(mature_mirna_id,target_symbol,.keep_all = TRUE)

miR_335_5p<-multimir_overall_validated_distinct%>%
   filter(mature_mirna_id=="hsa-miR-335-5p")

listEnrichrSites()
setEnrichrSite("Enrichr") # Human genes
websiteLive <- TRUE
dbs <- listEnrichrDbs()

dbs<-c("GO_Molecular_Function_2015","GO_Cellular_Component_2015", "GO_Biological_Process_2015","KEGG")
if (websiteLive) {
    enriched <- enrichr(miR_335_5p$target_symbol, dbs)
}

if (websiteLive) enriched[["GO_Biological_Process_2015"]]
pdf("DESeq2/Plots/GO_miR-335-5p.pdf",width=10)
if (websiteLive) {
    plotEnrich(enriched[[3]], showTerms = 20, numChar = 40, y = "Count", orderBy = "P.value",title="GO biological processes enriched among hsa-miR-335-5p targets")
}
dev.off()


miR_27a_3p<-multimir_overall_validated_distinct%>%
   filter(mature_mirna_id=="hsa-miR-27a-3p")
```

## plot expression differences for genes of interest
```{r}
#overall hit

miR_335_5p_exp<-as.data.frame(assay(vsd)[rownames(vsd)=="hsa-miR-335-5p",])
miR_335_5p_exp<-miR_335_5p_exp%>%
  rownames_to_column(var="bam")%>%
  left_join(Covariates)%>%
  dplyr::rename(miR_335_5p=2)

pdf("DESeq2/Plots/miR_335_5p.pdf")
miR_335_5p_exp%>%
ggplot(.,aes(x=combined_group,y=miR_335_5p))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.05,alpha=0.5)+
  stat_summary(geom="point",fun="mean",shape=23,fill="#E7298A",size=6)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title="miR-335-5p expression across groups",y="log normalized counts")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("Normotensive_No","Preeclampsia_No","Preeclampsia_Yes"),
        labels=c("Normotensive", "Preeclampsia (-H)", "Preeclampsia (+H)"))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(size=12))
dev.off()

  labs(title="miR-30e-3p expression across groups",y="log normalized counts")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("Normotensive_No","Preeclampsia_No","Preeclampsia_Yes"),
        labels=c("Normotensive", "Preeclampsia (-H)", "Preeclampsia (+H)"))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(size=12))
dev.off()

miR_142_5p_exp<-as.data.frame(assay(vsd)[rownames(vsd)=="hsa-miR-142-5p",])
miR_142_5p_exp<-miR_142_5p_exp%>%
  rownames_to_column(var="bam")%>%
  left_join(Covariates)%>%
  dplyr::rename(miR_142_5p=2)

pdf("DESeq2/Plots/miR_142_5p.pdf")
miR_142_5p_exp%>%
ggplot(.,aes(x=combined_group,y=miR_142_5p))+
  geom_jitter(width=0.05,alpha=0.5)+
  stat_summary(geom="point",fun="mean",shape=23,fill="#E7298A",size=6)+
  theme_bw()+
  labs(title="miR-142-5p expression across groups",y="log normalized counts")+
  scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("Normotensive_No","Preeclampsia_No","Preeclampsia_Yes"),
        labels=c("Normotensive", "Preeclampsia (-H)", "Preeclampsia (+H)"))+
  theme(axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(size=12))
dev.off()
```
